test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who is the first law officer of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Attorney General of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first law officer** of India is the** Attorney General of India.**
 
• The Attorney General of India is the** chief legal advisor **to the Government of India and** represents the Government of India **in all legal matters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Advocate General of State: **The Advocate General is the **chief legal advisor **to the **state government **and represents the state government in all legal matters.
 
• **Chief Justice of India:** The Chief Justice of India is the** head of the judiciary **in India and is responsible for the **administration of justice **in the country.
 
• **Minister of law: **The Minister of Law is a** political position** and is responsible for the **formulation of laws and policies **related to the legal system in India.
 
• Hence, the **correct **answer is option 3.
